definition: The variety of plant and animal life in a particular habitat.
example: The new law aims to protect the biodiversity of the Amazon rainforest.

definition: To make something poisonous or less pure by adding something harmful.
example: Industrial waste continues to contaminate the local water supply.

definition: The quality of being able to continue over a long period of time without harming the environment.
example: The government is promoting sustainability in the agricultural sector.

definition: A reduction in something, or the act of reducing something, such as natural resources.
example: The depletion of the ozone layer is a major global concern.

definition: All the living things in an area and the way they affect each other and the environment.
example: Pollution can have a devastating effect on the marine ecosystem.

definition: The production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.
example: Carbon dioxide emissions from cars are a primary cause of global warming.

definition: Animals or plants that may soon not exist because there are very few now alive.
example: The giant panda is one of the most famous endangered species in the world.

definition: The gradual destruction of tissue or soil by natural forces like wind or water.
example: Coastal erosion has increased significantly due to rising sea levels.

definition: The natural environment in which an animal or plant usually lives.
example: Deforestation is destroying the natural habitat of many wild animals.

definition: In a way that cannot be avoided.
example: If we do not act now, global temperatures will inevitably rise.

definition: To make something less harmful, unpleasant, or bad.
example: Planting more trees is a simple way to mitigate the effects of climate change.

definition: Energy from a source that is not depleted when used, such as wind or solar power.
example: The country is shifting its focus toward renewable energy sources.

definition: The protection of plants and animals, natural areas, or important structures.
example: Wildlife conservation is essential for maintaining a healthy planet.

definition: The cutting down of trees in a large area; the destruction of forests by people.
example: Deforestation contributes to about 15 percent of all greenhouse gas emissions.

definition: A substance that pollutes something, especially water or the atmosphere.
example: Nitrogen oxide is a common air pollutant produced by jet engines.

definition: An item that is intended to be thrown away after use.
example: We should reduce our use of disposable plastic bottles to save the oceans.

definition: A chemical substance used to kill harmful insects or plants.
example: The use of chemical pesticides can harm birds and beneficial insects.

definition: A sudden event that causes very great trouble or destruction.
example: Scientists warn that an environmental catastrophe is possible if carbon levels don't drop.

definition: The process by which more and more people leave the countryside to live in cities.
example: Rapid urbanization often leads to the loss of green spaces in a city.

definition: New or almost new, and in very good condition; unspoiled.
example: The island is famous for its pristine beaches and crystal clear water.

definition: Relating to schools, colleges, and universities, or connected with studying and thinking.
example: The university provides a wide range of academic courses for international students.

definition: The group of subjects studied in a school, college, or university.
example: The school is adding coding and robotics to its primary curriculum.

definition: The practice of making people obey rules or standards of behavior.
example: A lack of discipline in the classroom can hinder the learning process.

definition: To officially join a class, school, or course.
example: Thousands of students enroll in online courses every year to gain new skills.

definition: The ability to read and write.
example: The government is launching a campaign to improve adult literacy rates.

definition: The methods and theory of teaching.
example: Modern pedagogy focuses more on student participation than traditional lectures.

definition: An official record showing that you have finished a training course or have the necessary skills.
example: You will need a teaching qualification to apply for a position at this college.

definition: An amount of money given by a school or organization to pay for a student's education.
example: She was awarded a full scholarship to study medicine at Oxford.

definition: Relating to education at a college or university level.
example: Access to tertiary education is essential for a country's economic development.

definition: The money paid for being taught, usually at a college or university.
example: Many students take out loans to cover the cost of their university tuition.

definition: Providing skills and education that prepare you for a specific job.
example: The college offers vocational training in carpentry and electrical work.

definition: Involving two or more people working together for a special purpose.
example: Collaborative learning helps students develop important social and teamwork skills.

definition: A way of studying where you do not attend a school but study at home using the internet.
example: Distance learning is a flexible option for people who work full-time.

definition: Complete and including everything that is necessary.
example: The course provides a comprehensive overview of 20th-century history.

definition: The act of judging or deciding the amount, value, quality, or importance of something.
example: Continuous assessment is often better than a single final exam.

definition: Something that must be done, or is demanded by law.
example: In many countries, primary education is mandatory for all children.

definition: Using a logical method of thinking about something in order to understand it.
example: University students are expected to develop strong analytical skills.

definition: Connected with thinking or conscious mental processes.
example: Puzzles and reading can help improve a child's cognitive development.

definition: A piece of work given to someone, typically as part of their studies.
example: The students were given a two-week deadline to complete their research assignment.

definition: A long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one that is done for a higher university degree.
example: He is currently writing his doctoral thesis on renewable energy policy.
